question: Should OpenClaw sponsor first-party Control UI math rendering here, and if so which renderer, dependency provenance, and default delimiter policy should be accepted?
rationale: The feature is useful and already has candidate PRs, but accepting it changes untrusted chat rendering and first-party browser code provenance in ways automation should not decide alone.

options.title: Track dependency and narrow parsing
options.body: Replace the opaque bundle with reviewed package/build provenance and remove `$...$` inline parsing unless maintainers explicitly accept that user-visible behavior change.

options.title: Accept owner-approved vendoring
options.body: Maintainers could intentionally accept a vendored MathJax asset only with documented source, license, version, update, and review provenance.

options.title: Defer global math rendering
options.body: Pause or close this PR and continue product/API discussion on the canonical feature request if global Control UI math support is not confirmed.

recommendation.title: Track dependency and narrow parsing
recommendation.body: Replace the opaque bundle with reviewed package/build provenance and remove `$...$` inline parsing unless maintainers explicitly accept that user-visible behavior change.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter Steinberger has the strongest historical ownership signal across the Control UI/Gateway files and is the best available route for the product/default decision.
